meta_description:
803 likes, 30 comments - financebyanmoll on October 7, 2026: "When big industrial groups start owning critical infrastructure like airports, profit will eventually take priority over passenger comfort.

Redeveloping Mumbai T1 is understandable. But forcing a chunk of international traffic away from T2 also raises another question: is this partly a strategic move to push traffic towards the new Navi Mumbai Airport?

Maybe it’s operational necessity. Maybe it also helps accelerate adoption of a new airport within the same ecosystem.

That’s the problem with crony capitalism , when ownership becomes concentrated, it gets harder to tell where public convenience ends and corporate interest begins. 💰✈️".
